name: docuframe
description: Give it a topic or a script, get a finished documentary or explainer film in the style you pick.

interface.shortDescription: Documentary and explainer films from a topic or a script.
interface.longDescription: Give it a topic or a script, get a finished documentary or explainer film in the style you pick. Everything on screen is drawn by code: titles, archive photos, maps, numbers, quotes, timelines, with sources and captions, in many languages including right-to-left.
defaultPrompt: Make a 3 minute documentary about the Great Molasses Flood of 1919.
Turn this script into a YouTube explainer with sources and chapters.
Make a 50 second vertical short about why the Suez Canal matters.
